info.name: Livestock ERP - Animal CRUD
info.description: Animal master CRUD using the normalized classification system. Base URL: http://localhost:8089/api/v1. Set access_token from the Auth collection, then run all folders in order against a development database. Requires setup.animals.view/create/update/delete. Lookups automatically select the first active type/category/breed; the type must have both child selections. Only two uniquely named test animals are written and then soft-deleted. No classification records are changed. Requests include live saved examples; example IDs are historical, so run the lookup/create steps to populate current IDs. POST is used for updates. Classification IDs are required numeric values; raw JSON uses unquoted variables for these IDs. No flat type/category/breed fields are supported.
